notes.title: The House Is Changing!
notes.content: [h1]Just A Couple Of Things [/h1][h2]From Lagarcent[/h2][p]Hey guys, I've taken a break from the development of Bleakmoor House these past couple of weeks to learn a few things. I've been working on a third person point of view game that'll be my main focus after "Bleakmoor House" and have learned alot! And I mean A LOT! So with this new knowledge I am in the process of modifying a few things as well as making a new map in blender. I realize the "Demo" wasn't the best and felt kind of rushed. The main game also didn't have much replayability and let's be honest what you have seen so far SUCKS!!! So, since I don't want to half ass a product I'm trying to sell; the game might take a bit longer than the planned release date. The plan is still to have the game out by the end of this year but probably not by Halloween as anticipated. I will list below the few things I am working on to improve the demo and the final product. The main vision is still there but hopefully.... HOPEFULLY, this will be a game YOU can be proud to play.[/p][h3][b]List of Current Changes[/b][/h3][olist][*][p]The Monster[/p][/*][*][p]The Map[/p][/*][*][p]Safe Rooms[/p][/*][*][p]DOORS (I Know Right!?)[/p][/*][*][p]Flashlight Instead of a Lamp[/p][/*][*][p]New Goal[/p][/*][*][p]Less Scripted Jumpscares[/p][/*][*][p]Improved "Monster AI"[/p][/*][*][p]Controller Support[/p][/*][/olist]
